# Project: Modern Profile Website (guns.lol alternative)

## Overview
A modern, dark-theme profile website where users can claim usernames and customize their public profiles without any sign-up or authentication system. Token-based editing for security.

## Core Technologies
- Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Vercel KV for storage
- Vercel Serverless Functions

## Key Features
- Username claiming with secure tokens
- Token-protected profile editing
- Public profile pages
- Profile customization (colors, fonts, layouts, effects)
- Social links and badges
- Image hosting
- Rate limiting and abuse prevention
- Auto-deletion of inactive profiles

## Development Guidelines
- No authentication system (token-based only)
- All features are 100% free
- Dark theme with glassmorphism effects
- Fully responsive design
- Optimized for Vercel deployment
